description: Update a subscription. Only the fields you send change; for renewalCronExpression, startDate, paymentDate and notes an empty string clears the stored value.

currencyCode.description: Uppercase ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, GBP, JPY.

value.description: Amount in the currency's minor units. Most currencies have 2 decimal places (1599 = 15.99 USD), but some have none (1500 = 1500 JPY) and a few have 3 (12345 = 12.345 KWD).

notes.description: Free-text notes. Empty string clears them.

paymentDate.description: Date the first payment leaves the account, YYYY-MM-DD, when it differs from the renewal date. Payments repeat on the renewal cadence from this date. Omit when payment happens on renewal. Empty string clears it.

remindMe.description: Whether to remind the household before each renewal.

renewalCronExpression.description: Cron expression for the renewal cadence, no more often than daily. Empty string clears it, making the bill a one-off.

startDate.description: Renewal date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional. For a recurring bill it is the first renewal; for a one-off it is the date it is due. Empty string clears it.

name: update_subscription
